name: Marketing Video Generator with Motion Graphics

parameters.name: messages

parameters.command:
=cd {{ $json.work_dir }} && \
npx remotion render Composition out/background.mp4 \
  --codec h264 \
  --width {{ $json.video_config.width }} \
  --height {{ $json.video_config.height }} \
  --fps {{ $json.video_config.fps }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO marketing_videos (feature_name, script, background_video_url, final_video_url, thumbnail_url, duration, has_motion_graphics) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
